records.summary: A 12-week framework for building a personal brand, focusing on foundation, content creation, and systems.
workflow_steps: Week 1: Foundation - Identify what's on your mind, what you can talk about repeatedly, and your current life stage.
Month 1: Creating Mastery - Start recording content, embrace the discomfort of being a beginner, and ignore the opinions of friends and family.
Week 2: Content Framework - Learn to repurpose one core idea into multiple formats (talking head, B-roll, green screen, carousel).
Week 3: 4 Content Types - Implement a mix of Education, Storytelling, Authority, and Double Down content.
Week 4: Analytics - Track watch time, shares, saves, and comments to identify what content is performing.
Month 2: Amplifying - Adjust content strategy based on audience journey (Discovery, Connection, Trust).
Month 3: Systems - Build a content calendar, film ahead, and integrate your offer (results, testimonials, proof).
tips: Stop trying to fit into a specific niche; your story and perspective are what build a brand.
Don't let friends and family influence your content; they are not your target audience.
Feel the cringe of early content creation and post it anyway; it's only cringe until it works.
Use data to guide your content strategy rather than guessing.
Balance your content mix: education builds followers, storytelling builds trust, and authority builds sales.

concepts.explanation: A brand built on your unique story, perspective, and experiences.
A system for repurposing a single concept into multiple content formats.
The stages of an audience's journey: Discovery, Connection, and Trust.
